# gigahost_dns_zone (Resource)

Manages a DNS zone on gigahost.no.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "gigahost_dns_zone" "example" {
  name = "example.no"
  type = "NATIVE"
}

output "zone_id" {
  value = gigahost_dns_zone.example.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Zone (domain) name.

### Optional

- `type` (String) Zone type: NATIVE, MASTER or SLAVE. Changing it **replaces** the zone.

### Read-Only

- `active` (Boolean) True when the zone is active.
- `external_dns` (Boolean) True when the zone uses external nameservers.
- `id` (String) Internal zone ID.
- `is_registered` (Boolean) True when the domain is registered.
- `protected` (Boolean) True when the zone is registered and cannot be deleted via API.
- `record_count` (Number) Number of DNS records in the zone.
- `registrar` (String) Domain registrar when registered.
- `updated_at` (Number) Unix timestamp of last zone update.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Find the zone ID (or use the zone name directly):
#   gigahost dns zones list
terraform import gigahost_dns_zone.example ZONE_ID
# ...or import by zone name:
terraform import gigahost_dns_zone.example example.no
```
